verdict.rationale: GitHub docs mention CI/CD tooling ('Ship faster with secure, reliable CI/CD') and enforcement-style security policies like push protection that blocks secret leaks, which speaks to some policy enforcement across an org. However, there is no evidence of core governance mechanisms devops-leads would need—branch protection rules, required status checks, CODEOWNERS, org-wide rulesets, or policy-as-code for CI/CD workflows across repos. Missing for 10: branch/repo rulesets, CODEOWNERS enforcement, org-wide required workflows, audit/compliance reporting across teams.
